condition: Boolean; unavailable condition yields unavailable, never the false branch
branches: Both branches validated statically; same type/unit and output row, literal scalar broadcast only. At runtime evaluate only the chosen branch.
result: Chosen branch value, including unavailable; no exception-to-null conversion
legacy: All old operators and old definition hashes retain their original policy. Only plans containing if add conditional_extension to identity.
errors: Invalid source/type/unit/relationship rejected before execution, even if branch not selected. Runtime exceptions in the chosen branch propagate.
